plain_summary: A consumer is a person who buys goods or uses services by paying money. It also includes online purchases.
who_it_helps: People who purchase products or use services, including online customers.

plain_summary: The rules establish responsibilities for e-commerce entities to protect consumers who purchase goods and services online.
who_it_helps: Consumers who purchase products or services through online platforms.

plain_summary: These amendment rules modify provisions of the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020.
who_it_helps: Consumers and e-commerce businesses affected by the amended rules.
